## Emergent associations at the end state

@fig-final-population captures cross-sectional agent states at the
simulation's conclusion, revealing theoretically grounded associations
among psychological variables. Resilience exhibits a weak positive
correlation with affect (`r final_corr("resilience", "affect")`), a moderate
negative correlation with stress (`r final_corr("resilience", "current_stress")`),
and a moderate negative correlation with PSS-10
(`r final_corr("resilience", "pss10")`). In contrast, stress shows a moderate
positive correlation with PSS-10 (`r corr_val("pss10_stress_final")`), up
from an essentially zero baseline association
(`r corr_val("pss10_stress_initial")`), accompanied by increasing dispersion
in stress levels at higher PSS-10 scores. This visualization
demonstrates model convergence toward expected relationships, validating
the simulation's capacity to generate plausible homeostatic mechanisms
of psychological dynamics.

![The emerging associations of agent psychological states captured at simulation completion](figures/full_model_final_population.pdf){#fig-final-population}
